Data for this (post-merge batch gate on green `3a240b7fb`, 898 steps, 53.4 min): the steps over 40 s, with the slowest test the gate names inside each:

| Step | Time | Slowest test(s) |
|---|---|---|
| motion suites: lib | **287 s** | `machining2d::adaptive_troch::tests::explicit_trochoidal_parameters_control_engagement_return_feed_and_loop_width` (>60 s), `machining2d::adaptive_troch::tests::pocket_with_island_is_cl...` |
| debug build (--no-run) | 237 s | (build) |
| ui suites: lib | **142 s** | `launch_file_tests::a_solidcraft_design_is_imported` (>60 s) |
| kernel suites: machining_mesh | 66 s | `solidcraft_sample_meshes_within_the_app_chord` (>60 s) |
| app suites: keep_law | 62 s | |
| app suites: carried_stock_entry | 59 s | |
| motion suites: rest_adaptive | 56 s | |
| app suites: lathe_field_sim | 55 s | |
| app suites: lib | 53 s | |
| app suites: adaptive_trochoid | 50 s | |

Note from the nextest measurement in #2727 (18.8 min cold, 8465 tests, 24 marked slow): once tests run in parallel, **binary size stops mattering and the single longest TEST sets the floor**. So the highest-value work is making the 4 named >60 s tests faster (slimmer fixtures, coarser tolerance in a debug test, or moving the full-precision version to the release lane as AGENTS.md's "~60 s moves to the heavy lane" rule says), rather than splitting binaries.

## Research findings for #2556

We measured per-test timings on `HEAD` `8643d9bb7` on a 16-core Linux host.
We invoked each compiled test binary directly with `--exact` per test.
`motion suites: lib` and `motion heavy: lib` ran while release targets compiled, so absolute seconds include mild host load.
Relative per-test shares and band skew do not depend on host load.

### 1. Which tests take the time (per-test timings)

**`app heavy: shared_face_bodies_finish`** (739 s on ccx43; release `--ignored`, 6 bands on 6 workers, wall 891.67 s, sum 1,685.07 s):

| Test | Release time (s) | Share | Status |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `the_sample_as_imported_3d_finish_band_6_of_6_has_no_gouge` | 891.66 | 52.9% | ok |
| `the_sample_as_imported_3d_finish_band_4_of_6_has_no_gouge` | 755.60 | 44.8% | ok |
| `the_sample_as_imported_3d_finish_band_5_of_6_has_no_gouge` | 21.72 | 1.3% | ok |
| `the_sample_as_imported_3d_finish_band_3_of_6_has_no_gouge` | 6.53 | 0.4% | ok |
| `the_sample_as_imported_3d_finish_band_1_of_6_has_no_gouge` | 5.43 | 0.3% | ok |
| `the_sample_as_imported_3d_finish_band_2_of_6_has_no_gouge` | 4.13 | 0.2% | ok |

Key finding: the six uniform Z bands (`BANDS = 6` in `crates/app/tests/shared_face_bodies_finish.rs:23`) have extreme skew.
Bands 4 and 6 take 1,647.26 s (97.8% of the binary).
Bands 1, 2, 3, and 5 finish in 37.81 s total (2.2%).
Even at `--test-threads=2`, Bands 4 and 6 already run at the same time.
Splitting this file into six binaries or sharding its six existing tests does not lower the 739 s floor.
We must split the Band 4 and Band 6 Z ranges into narrower sub-bands.

**`motion suites: lib`** (726 s on ccx43; 287 s on post-merge batch `3a240b7fb`; debug, 434 active tests, CPU sum 4,594.3 s):

| Test | Debug time (s) | File |
|---|---:|---|

Key finding: 14 tests over 60 s take 4,022.9 s (87.6% of all 434 tests).
The other 420 tests take 571.4 s (12.4%).
Three tests in `machining2d/adaptive/air_rings_tests.rs` (lines 76, 87, 102) recompute `ring_plan()` three times (35.3 s + 42.7 s + 43.3 s = 121.3 s).
Sibling `l_shaped_pocket_is_cleared_under_engagement_limit` (`adaptive_troch_tests.rs:331`) already uses `#[ignore = "heavy lane: ..."]`.

**`app heavy: rotary_field_parity`** (417 s on ccx43; release `--ignored`, 6 tests on 6 workers, wall 458.47 s, sum 993.14 s):

| Test | Release time (s) | Status |
|---|---:|---|
| `the_contour_kind_reads_the_radial_law` | 458.47 | ok |
| `the_parallel_kind_reads_the_radial_law` | 264.69 | ok |
| `the_offset_kind_reads_the_radial_law` | 243.32 | ok |
| `the_contour_kinds_eye_cost_is_measured` | 13.15 | ok |
| `the_offset_kinds_eye_cost_is_measured` | 9.39 | ok |
| `the_parallel_kinds_eye_cost_is_measured` | 4.12 | ok |

Key finding: the three `eye_cost` tests run the full rotary stock simulation in 4-13 s.
The test-only oracle `law_cut(&cs, p)` (`crates/app/tests/rotary_field_parity.rs:84-105`) causes almost all of the 243-458 s runtime.
It scans every sample in `centers(&moves)` (`H = 0.01` mm) linearly for every march step and every 3D sign probe.
`law_floor` runs up to five times per cut column for steepness checks (lines 212-228).

**`motion heavy: lib`** (752 s on `dude`, 232 s early #1950 fail on ccx43; release `--ignored`, 10 tests, serial sum 945.13 s):

| Test | Release time (s) | Status | Cause |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `budget::twins::the_r7_bars_levels_decide_the_same_way_under_sub_micron_perturbations` | 353.44 | ok | spawns 5 internal threads (`budget_twins.rs:111`) |
| `adaptive::tests::the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations` | 201.28 | ok | 20 serial plans in one loop (`adaptive/tests.rs:118`) |
| `budget::twins::the_windows_levels_decide_the_same_way_under_sub_micron_perturbations` | 197.02 | ok | spawns 5 internal threads (`budget_twins.rs:125`) |
| `adaptive_troch::tests::l_shaped_pocket_is_cleared_under_engagement_limit` | 92.86 | ok | 2 serial `check_cleared` runs (`adaptive_troch_tests.rs:332`) |
| `rings::simplify::tests::a_fine_ended_slot_charges_growth_vertices_near_its_coarse_twin` | 61.21 | ok | fine-vs-coarse slot pair |
| `budget::fixtures::the_fixtures_that_grow_today_stay_under_the_geometry_budget` | 22.37 | ok | fixture suite |
| `pocket_hsm::ring_tests::the_stock_ring_level_plans_adaptive_with_no_budget_note` | 9.26 | expected-red (#1950) | `pocket_hsm_ring.rs:104` |
| `pocket_hsm::ring_tests::the_stock_ring_level_reaches_the_air_planner_with_the_stock` | 5.15 | expected-red (#1950) | `pocket_hsm_ring.rs:82` |
| `adaptive::air_rings::tests::probe_air_hops` | 1.57 | ok | reading probe |
| `pocket_hsm::ring_tests::probe_air_slack` | 0.99 | ok | reading probe |

**Other slow debug targets from the issue table and `3a240b7fb` batch data:**
- `kernel suites: machining_mesh`: `solidcraft_sample_meshes_within_the_app_chord` (`crates/kernel/tests/machining_mesh.rs:29`) took 128.71 s locally (66 s on post-merge batch).
- `ui suites: lib`: `launch_file_tests::a_solidcraft_design_is_imported` took 142 s on post-merge batch (`3a240b7fb`, added after `8643d9bb7`) in the exclusive UI lane.
- `app suites: adaptive_trochoid` (245 s on `8643d9bb7`): `mcp_edits_trochoidal_parameters_generates_refuses_limits_and_round_trips` took 107.09 s locally. Its `max_engagement: 10.0` check runs all 11 rungs of `LADDER` (`trochoid_slot.rs:37`) through dexel measurement.
- `app suites: keep_law` (235 s on `8643d9bb7`): 31 debug tests took 529.3 s CPU total with zero tests over 60 s. Ten balanced `adaptive_*` tests took 39.3-52.7 s each. `--test-threads=2` serialized them into 235 s, so Option C sharding cuts this binary directly.

### 2. Option comparison: split binaries vs shard inside `xtask` vs slim/fix tests

Per-test timings confirm the maintainer's 2026-11-19 observation.
Single slow tests set the floor first.
The 2-thread lane budget (`xtask/src/budget.rs:27-33`) sets the floor second.

- **Option A (Split into more `crates/*/tests/*.rs` binaries): reject.**
  - It does not speed up single-test floors (`band_4`/`band_6`, `the_contour_kind_reads_the_radial_law`, `the_r7_bars_levels...`, or `triangle_and_wide_to_narrow_neck_are_cleared`).
  - `camcraft-motion --lib` cannot move its slow unit tests into `tests/*.rs`. All seven slow files import private `pub(super)` or `#[cfg(test)]` hooks (`OPEN_INSET`, `PEAK`, `PEAK_LEN`, `plan_from_air`, `cut_lane`, `plan_all_lanes`, `hsm_passes`).
- **Option B (Fix, slim, or sub-band the slow tests): do first.**
  - Move or slim the 14 over-60 s debug tests in `motion --lib` and the two Solidcraft debug tests per `AGENTS.md` ("Testing").
  - Sub-band the slow Z band(s) in `shared_face_bodies_finish.rs`.
  - Add a spatial index to test-only `law_cut` in `rotary_field_parity.rs`.
  - Split the 20-run loop and 5-thread pools in `motion heavy: lib`.
- **Option C (Shard long queued binaries by `<exe> --list` inside `xtask`): do second.**
  - After Option B splits multi-case heavy tests, `xtask` discovers test names via `<exe> --list` after `--no-run`.
  - `--list` captures macro-generated tests such as `band!` that `scan::test_fns` misses.
  - `xtask` enqueues shards as `<step name> [k/n]` with `--exact`, staying under Windows's 32 KB `CreateProcessW` cap (`camcraft-motion --lib` active names total 35,086 chars).
  - This stays compatible with `#2557` if the gate later adopts `cargo nextest`.

### 3. Does this keep every test and every golden assert?

Yes.
- None of the four named binaries use external `.cl` golden files. (`adaptive_trochoid.rs` and `rotary_adaptive.rs` own the `.cl` and ring goldens and stay untouched.)
- Moving over-60 s debug tests to `#[ignore = "heavy lane: ..."]` keeps the exact `#[test]` count. Every assertion still runs in release at the cut.
- Splitting multi-case tests (`budget_twins.rs`, `adaptive/tests.rs`, `shared_face_bodies_finish.rs`, two-case `check_cleared` pairs) increases the `#[test]` count and keeps every assertion.
- Sharding via `<exe> --list` asserts in `xtask` that shard union coverage matches `--list` with zero missing or duplicate tests.

### 4. Build time and gate-map upkeep cost

This checkout has 865 integration test binaries and 862 `Gate map` headers (`xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs`).

| Option | New binaries | Link and disk cost | Gate-map upkeep |
|---|---:|---|---|
| A. Split into more `tests/*.rs` binaries | 10+ in `app` (impossible for `motion --lib` private hooks) | 75-134 MB debug and 24-53 MB release per `app` binary (~1 GB debug disk; 10+ extra full `app` links in both profiles) | One new `Gate map` header per file |
| B. Fix, slim, or sub-band slow tests | 0 | Zero | Zero |
| C. Shard by `<exe> --list` in `xtask` | 0 | Zero (uses existing `--no-run` binaries) | Zero |

### Design proposal (smallest useful first slice first)

Recommended option: **Option B first, then Option C** (zero new binaries, zero Gate-map churn).

1. **Slice 1 (Debug batch and release debug floor):** Move or slim the 14 over-60 s debug tests in `camcraft-motion --lib`. Split moved two-case `check_cleared` tests into single-case heavy tests. Cache `ring_plan()` in `air_rings_tests.rs` with `OnceLock`. This cuts `motion suites: lib` from 726 s to ~90 s on ccx43 (and 287 s to ~35 s on post-merge batch).
2. **Slice 2 (Batch and exclusive UI floor):** Move or slim the two Solidcraft debug tests in `camcraft-kernel` (`machining_mesh.rs:29`) and `camcraft-ui` (`launch_file_tests::a_solidcraft_design_is_imported`). This saves ~2 min directly in the exclusive UI lane and brings `machining_mesh` under 30 s.
3. **Slice 3 (Release #1 floor):** Replace equal-Z `BANDS = 6` in `shared_face_bodies_finish.rs` with unbalanced Z edges that sub-band the slow band(s) under 150 s each.
4. **Slice 4 (Release #3 floor):** Add a spatial grid index to test-only `law_cut` in `rotary_field_parity.rs`. This cuts `rotary_field_parity` from 417 s to under 60 s with zero product-code changes.
5. **Slice 5 (Release `motion heavy: lib` floor):** Split the 5-thread `budget_twins` pools, the 20-run serial slot loop, and the 2-case `l_shaped_pocket` test into separate `#[test]` functions. This cuts the single-test floor from 353 s to ~70-90 s and ends lane oversubscription.
6. **Slice 6 (Queue fan-out without new binaries):** Shard long queued binaries by `<exe> --list` in `xtask`. Slices 3 and 5 then fan out across all 8 release lanes instead of stalling on `--test-threads=2`.

**Expected gate time on 16-core ccx43 (`8643d9bb7` baseline = 52.7 min):**
- Release builds: ~7 min (unchanged).
- Heavy phase: single-step floor drops from 739 s and 417 s to ~120-180 s per longest shard (saves ~9-11 min).
- Debug phase plus exclusive UI: `motion suites: lib` drops from 726 s to ~90 s and `ui suites: lib` drops by ~2 min (saves ~10-12 min).
- Projected release gate wall time: **~30-34 min** (down from 52.7 min). No single test step sets a 7-12 min floor.

### Filed sub-issues

We filed all six sub-issues with `Part of #2556`. This umbrella stays open for maintainer review.

1. #3427 — `Test speed: move or slim the over-60 s debug tests in camcraft-motion lib` (`P5`, `effort:medium`, `area:build`)
   - Moves or slims the 14 over-60 s debug tests in `camcraft-motion --lib` and caches `ring_plan()`.
   - Done means: no debug test exceeds 60 s, moved tests pass in release `--ignored`, and `motion suites: lib` finishes under 90 s.
2. #3428 — `Test speed: move or slim the over-60 s Solidcraft debug tests in camcraft-kernel and camcraft-ui` (`P5`, `effort:medium`, `area:build`)
   - Moves or slims the full Solidcraft debug tests in `machining_mesh.rs:29` and `crates/ui`.
   - Done means: no active debug test exceeds 60 s, full-chord checks pass in release `--ignored`, and test counts hold.
3. #3432 — `Test speed: split the heavy Z bands of shared_face_bodies_finish into balanced sub-bands` (`P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:build`)
   - Replaces uniform `BANDS = 6` with explicit Z edges that sub-band the slow band range(s).
   - Done means: every heavy band finishes under 150 s in release, bands tile the 118 mm span, and test count increases.
4. #3429 — `Test speed: add a spatial index to the test oracle in rotary_field_parity` (`P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:build`)
   - Adds a 3D spatial grid index to test-only `law_cut` in `rotary_field_parity.rs`.
   - Done means: all tests pass with unchanged tolerances and assertions, and release wall time drops below 60 s.
5. #3430 — `Test speed: split multi-run loops and internal thread pools in motion heavy lib tests` (`P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:build`)
   - Splits `budget_twins` 5-thread pools, the 20-run slot loop, and `l_shaped_pocket` D10/D6 into separate `#[test]` functions.
   - Done means: no heavy test spawns an internal pool or runs 20 serial plans, all checks pass in release, and test count increases.
6. #3431 — `Gate: shard long queued test binaries by libtest --list names in xtask` (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:build`)
   - Shards long queued binaries via `<exe> --list` and `--exact` inside `xtask` with zero new binaries.
   - Done means: multi-test binaries fan out across all lanes, unit tests pin `--list` coverage and `timings.tsv` sums, and `xtask` passes.

Maintainer decision, 2026-11-22, given in the question dialog: **the plan is approved.** Re-band the two slow bands of `shared_face_bodies_finish`, move the 14 slow tests of `motion suites: lib` to the heavy lane with light twins, and reuse the plan in the three air-ring tests. The count of tests and every golden assert stay. The coordinator files one sub-issue for each part (P5). Splitting binaries is not part of the plan.

The three sub-issues of the approved plan are filed:
- https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3513 (the two slow bands of `shared_face_bodies_finish`)
- https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3514 (the 14 slow motion lib tests, heavy lane with light twins)
- https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3515 (`ring_plan()` in the three `air_rings_tests`)

No test binary is split. #2557 waits for this work.
